title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on Revelation 12: the woman clothed with the sun, the great red dragon and the war in the sky.

questions.text: What was on the head of the woman in the great sign?
questions.explanation: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon under her feet and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

answers.text: A rainbow and a cloud
A golden crown of victory
A crown of twelve stars
Seven crowns like the dragon’s

questions.text: How many heads and horns did the great red dragon have?
questions.explanation: Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

answers.text: Ten heads and seven horns
Seven heads and ten horns
Four heads and twelve horns
Two horns like a lamb

questions.text: What did the dragon’s tail do?
questions.explanation: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky and threw them to the earth.

answers.text: It struck one third of the sun and the moon
It dried up the water of the great river
It swallowed up a river of water
It drew one third of the stars and threw them to the earth

questions.text: What happened to the woman’s child?
questions.explanation: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron, and her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

answers.text: He was caught up to God and to his throne
He was devoured by the dragon
He was hidden in the wilderness
He was sealed on his forehead

questions.text: For how long is the woman nourished in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

answers.text: Forty-two months in the wilderness
One thousand two hundred sixty days
Five months and five days
Three and a half days

questions.text: Who made war on the dragon in the sky?
questions.explanation: There was war in the sky: Michael and his angels made war on the dragon, and the dragon and his angels made war.

answers.text: The two witnesses
The four living creatures
The seven angels with the trumpets
Michael and his angels

questions.text: What names does the text give the great dragon that was thrown down?
questions.explanation: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world.

answers.text: The old serpent, the devil and Satan
The angel of the pit of the abyss
The false prophet of the beast
The beast that came out of the sea

questions.text: According to the loud voice in heaven, how did they overcome him?
questions.explanation: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood and because of the word of their testimony, and they didn’t love their life, even to death.

answers.text: Because of the fire from their mouths
Because of the seal on their foreheads
Because of the Lamb’s blood and the word of their testimony
Because of the song they sang before the throne

questions.text: What was given to the woman so that she could fly into the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place.

answers.text: A white cloud to sit upon
Two wings of the great eagle
A horse prepared for war
A chariot of fire from heaven

questions.text: How was the woman saved from the river the dragon spewed out?
questions.explanation: The earth helped the woman: the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

answers.text: An angel came and dried up the water
The river turned into blood and dried up
The earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river
She was carried up into heaven in a cloud
